content:
According to a series of leaks regarding the three colour options when the iPhone 18 Pro is unveiled next week, there is already a clear consensus on two of them.

However, two well-known leakers hold differing views on whether the third colour will be silver or black…

So far, every leak has been in agreement on two of the expected colours, although there remains a degree of uncertainty over the exact shade of the purple one:

  • Deep Cherry / Wine Red
  • Sky Blue

But for the third colour—whether silver or black—there have been conflicting reports, with two authoritative leakers each staking out a position in this debate.

Black…

Just yesterday, Fixed Focus Digital said the third colour would be black, and that silver was "most likely" not going to be part of this colour lineup. Fans of silver can take some comfort in the fact that Sky Blue will very likely be the same extremely pale tone used for the iPhone Air and MacBook Air, which reads more as silver under most lighting conditions.

If that turns out to be true, it will make a lot of people very happy, as many were disappointed that the iPhone 17 Pro lacked a black or space grey option.

…or Silver

However, although Sonny Dickson did not directly contradict this claim, he responded by posting a photo purporting to show the SIM trays in all three colours, with the third being silver. He had previously shared images that included a black version, but now says he has not seen that colour reappear in recent months.

Which one are you hoping for?

Which take do you hope is right? Cast your vote in our poll and share your thoughts in the comments.
